set.body: from_bids() currently requires an explicit mask= path for file-backed datasets (fmri_dataset needs a mask). Enhance to auto-resolve the per-subject/space fmriprep brain mask (sub-XX_..._desc-brain_mask.nii.gz) via bidser (mask_files/create_preproc_mask/query_files on desc=brain), falling back to explicit mask. Verify the bidser mask API first.
set.title: from_bids(): auto-resolve fmriprep brain mask
